generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: All Tenderes shall provide the requested information accurately and in sufficient details in section 3 Qaulification information.

To qualify for award of this Contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26. a. achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover ( in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs. 16.80 lakhs (usually not less rhan Estimated cost of work under this construction) (Trun over certificate issued by CA along with UDIN is required).

To qualify for award of this Contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26. b. satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work of value not less than Rs.8.40 Lakhs

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability of owning the following Key and critical equipment for this work. GPS and other Survey instruments and Soil excavator such as Hitachi/JCB (Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.)

Liquid assets and / or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 5 lakhs (Credit lines/letter of credit certificates from banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc. (usually 30% of the amount put to tender).
Contractor should be registered as Forest Contractor in Belagavi District for the year 2026-27
Copies of GST Returns of past three years
Income tax returned filed documents for the year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 to be enclosed.
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours including EPF & ESI details to be uploaded) along with copy of Registration in Labour Department, EPF & ESI Registration Certificate
For address proof any only copy of Adhar,PAN Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).
Tenders should have experience for architectural planning habitat/ enclosure design in any recognised zoological park, rescue and rehabilitation facility for avirary design works.
Inspect the work site and throw Range Forest Officer Savadatti obtain a certificate and upload the same in the kppp portal before last date of the Tender (Its Compalsary).
